release_title: JOSHY Audio Playback Suite v1.0.1 (Accessible Edition)
release_overview: JOSHY is a high-performance Windows audio playback system engineered specifically for blind and visually impaired users. It delivers zero-latency keyboard-driven media playback, rich acoustic earcons, deep Spotify desktop integration, and native screen-reader bridges for NVDA, JAWS, and Windows Narrator without requiring visual interaction.
changelog: v1.0.1: JOSHY now uses its permanent server address api.mikeytech.dev for license and update checks. High-performance accessible Windows audio playback and Spotify controller featuring dual-layer hardware trial hardening, self-healing NVDA/JAWS/SAPI client extraction, acoustic earcons, and direct Git distribution.

installer.title: JOSHY Windows Installer
installer.target_audience: Blind and visually impaired users with NVDA, JAWS, or Windows Narrator. Installs desktop & start menu shortcuts and handles automatic extraction.

portable.title: JOSHY Standalone Portable Executable
portable.target_audience: Single-binary native C machine-code executable. Runs instantly from USB or disk without administrative rights or installation.

git_source.title: Direct Git Repository & Source Code
git_source.target_audience: Developers, auditors, and power users who prefer pulling directly from Git or building from source.
